_readme: Optional. Copy to sporty-autobet.config.json only if you need to change something here.
sporty-autobet.config.json is gitignored — it never leaves your machine.
NOTHING IN THIS FILE CAN CHANGE THE STAKE. The stake is fixed at ₦10 per code
inside autobet-engine.js (MAX_STAKE) and is not read from config. Same for the
3-leg minimum, the one-market-per-match rule, and the flex thresholds — they are
constants on purpose, so a config typo can never turn into a bigger bet.
browser      — 'chrome' (default) drives the Chrome already installed here.
'chromium' uses Playwright's bundled build instead.
chromeUserDataDir / chromeProfile — set these ONLY if you want to reuse a login
that already exists in a real Chrome profile, e.g.
"chromeUserDataDir": "C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data",
"chromeProfile": "Profile 2"
Chrome must be COMPLETELY closed first — Chrome locks its profile and
no second process can open it. Leave both null to use the tool's own
profile, which is the safer default: you sign in once and it persists.
maxSlips     — never place more than this many codes in one run.
headless     — true is fast and invisible. Set false to watch the browser work.
timeoutMs    — per-action browser timeout.
betweenSlipsMs — pause between codes.
selectors    — only add entries here if something stops being found. Each key takes
a list of CSS/Playwright selectors; the first visible one wins. This is
how you repair a SportyBet redesign without touching any code.
Keys: loggedIn, loginLink, betslip, selectionRow, betCount, stakeInput,
removeAll, dialogOk, dialogAny, multipleTab, activeTab, flexCheckbox,
placeButton, successMarker, errorMarker
Current live values (verified against sportybet.com/ng):
selectionRow  .m-betslip-wrapper .m-item
betCount      .m-bet-count
stakeInput    .m-betslip-wrapper input.m-input   (placeholder 'min. 10')
removeAll     span.m-text-min:has-text("Remove All")
flexCheckbox  .flexibet-checkbox-container
placeButton   button.af-button--primary  (also reads 'Accept Changes')
